plugins.name: runbooks
plugins.description: Skills for creating and maintaining operational runbooks with consistent structure and built-in maintenance feedback loops.

plugins.name: critique
plugins.description: Review skills for code, tests, documentation, observability, and skill portability. Finds design, coverage, doc-structure, logging/error-message, and agent-harness-coupling issues that linters miss.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: Skills for creating, maintaining, and enforcing Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) as standalone, append-only policy. MADR format with AI-native metadata, ADR-to-ADR relationship tracking, registration in the project's agent instructions (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md), and policy compliance review of code changes against accepted ADRs.

plugins.name: work-epic
plugins.description: Skill for orchestrating a hew epic across herdr-managed agents. Resolves the epic's ready children deterministically, spawns one worker agent per child running work-issue, runs a review-code reviewer agent over each delivered PR, files the findings as epic children, and — by default — merges PRs once CI is green and fast-forwards main. --human-review stops at drafts and leaves every merge to the human.

plugins.name: lightspec
plugins.description: Skills for the lightspec spec pipeline: draft a feature spec into specs/NNN-slug/spec.md in a script-enforced format, approve it on substance, and convert an accepted spec into a hew epic with one child issue per user story. ADR → spec → approve → tracker.

plugins.name: hew
plugins.description: Skills for tracking work in GitHub Issues via the hew CLI. Files review findings as deduplicated issues using a stable review key, and takes a tracked issue — or a bounded batch of them, verified together — from claimed to draft PR test-first, driven by the issue's own acceptance checklist.
